propositions: The close precheck scans historical commit messages and calls resolve_ticket_id for every extracted reference, causing unrelated ambiguous-prefix errors to print to stderr.
resolve_ticket_id prints ambiguity diagnostics directly to stderr regardless of caller context, creating noise in precheck output even when gate decisions are unaffected.
Adding a quiet keyword-only parameter to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr ambiguity prints without changing resolver return values or gate semantics.
_referencing_commit_exists passes quiet=True for history-scan candidates only, preserving full diagnostics for explicit user-supplied ambiguous prefixes in other commands.
Close gate correctly detects valid full-ID commit references while suppressing diagnostics for unrelated historical ambiguous short prefixes.
